annotation_protocol: AI-assisted source-only visual review of every one-second contact sheet, refined using original frames. No production predictions were inspected before freezing. Labels describe first source-visible persistent informational pages/builds, excluding speaker motion, camera layout changes and animation interpolation. Boundary uncertainty +/-1 second; one-to-one matches. Human verification pending; these labels are fallible, not human ground truth. Code ROI text was independently transcribed from source frames, not OCR. No-slide or continuously animated windows are explicitly not applicable.

39c3-2042.notes: All 180 seconds reviewed: craft/demo montage, generated snowflake animation, rotating hanging ornaments, and flipping notebooks. No conventional stable slide deck or code in this fixed window. Ordinary animated/video scene changes are not slide-boundary ground truth; slide precision/recall is not applicable. The presenter/layout cut at 50s does not change instructional content.

39c3-1611.notes: Full 180-second source review: USB Type-C title, incremental USB history bullets, revised USB naming text, connector diagram, wrong/wrong/correct USB orientation image, then USB-C pin diagram. Bullet additions count as informational builds. Presenter-only camera intervals and subsequent layout/zoom changes are excluded. At ~70s the deck returns with a newly visible fourth bullet; its exact hidden off-camera update is unknowable, so the labeled time is first visible return, not an invented earlier transition. Boundary timestamps checked against direct full-size source frames and rounded to one-second resolution. No source code appears in this fixed window.
